paragraphs.en: New games are shipping faster than anyone can talk about them. Find the small, surprising projects hiding on GitHub.
paragraphs.zh: 新游戏的发布速度快得让人来不及一一谈论。 去发现那些藏在 GitHub 上的小型、令人惊喜的项目。

sents.en: New games are shipping faster than anyone can talk about them.
sents.zh: 新游戏的发布速度快得让人来不及一一谈论。

sents.en: Find the small, surprising projects hiding on GitHub.
sents.zh: 去发现那些藏在 GitHub 上的小型、令人惊喜的项目。

paragraphs.en: Carry a spool across a small planet and connect your thread to restore color.
paragraphs.zh: 带着一个线轴穿越一颗小星球，将你的线连接起来，恢复色彩。

paragraphs.en: Every one is open source, with a way to play it today.
paragraphs.zh: 每一个都是开源的，并且今天就有可以上手试玩的方式。

paragraphs.en: Build a base, harvest scrap, and send flying and ground drones against a rival army in a phone-friendly RTS.
paragraphs.zh: 在一款适合手机操作的即时战略游戏中，建立基地、收集废料，并派出飞行和地面无人机对抗敌军。

paragraphs.en: Steer a growing hole through a low-poly city and swallow larger objects as you progress.
paragraphs.zh: 操控一个不断变大的洞穿越低多边形城市，随着前进吞下越来越大的物体。

paragraphs.en: Fight bot opponents in a tactical browser shooter with sliding and weapon handling.
paragraphs.zh: 在具有滑铲和武器操控机制的战术类浏览器射击游戏中对抗机器人对手。

paragraphs.en: Roam a Taiwanese village as a grandmother in a small open-world browser game.
paragraphs.zh: 在小型开放世界浏览器游戏中，扮演一位奶奶漫游台湾村庄。

paragraphs.en: Travel between procedural islands, collect resources, and fight enemies along the way.
paragraphs.zh: 在程序化生成的岛屿之间旅行，沿途收集资源并对抗敌人。

paragraphs.en: Build a hero, gather loot, and fight through a pixel action RPG manually or in idle mode.
paragraphs.zh: 打造英雄、收集战利品，在像素动作 RPG 中手动战斗或挂机游玩。

paragraphs.en: Join round-based team battles set in the streets of Taipei.
paragraphs.zh: 加入以台北街头为背景的回合制团队战斗。

paragraphs.en: Steer a boat through a Japanese river valley as the seasons and light change.
paragraphs.zh: 驾驶一艘小船穿越日本的河谷，感受季节与光影的变化。

paragraphs.en: Fly through a dense vertical city and attempt its time trials.
paragraphs.zh: 飞越一座密集的垂直城市并尝试其中的计时赛。

paragraphs.en: Deduce dungeon walls from row and column clues while leaving every monster in a dead end.
paragraphs.zh: 根据行和列的线索推导地牢墙壁，同时让每只怪物都处于死胡同中。

paragraphs.en: Experiment with a cartoon ragdoll and a collection of physics contraptions.
paragraphs.zh: 体验一个卡通布娃娃和一系列物理装置的实验。

paragraphs.en: Survive a figure-eight race or become the last car running in a demolition bowl.
paragraphs.zh: 在八字形竞速中存活下来，或成为撞车大赛中最后仍在行驶的汽车。

paragraphs.en: Settle into a seaside village, choose a hero, and follow a pixel-art adventure alone or in Party Mode.
paragraphs.zh: 在海边村庄安顿下来，选择一位英雄，独自或与好友组队模式一同踏上像素风冒险之旅。

paragraphs.en: Wander a sunrise-lit beach, borrow a car, and explore a peaceful coastal sandbox.
paragraphs.zh: 漫步在晨光初照的海滩上，借一辆车，探索一片宁静的海岸沙盒世界。

paragraphs.en: Fight through a wuxia arena with real-time sword combat.
paragraphs.zh: 在武侠竞技场中战斗，体验实时剑术对决。

paragraphs.en: Descend a pixel-art tower with other players and fight its bosses.
paragraphs.zh: 与其他玩家一起下降像素风格的塔，并击败塔中的首领。

paragraphs.en: Cut through crowds of voxel soldiers in a browser action game with officers, campaigns, and trials.
paragraphs.zh: 在浏览器动作游戏中突破成群的体素士兵，游戏包含军官、战役和试炼。

paragraphs.en: Pilot a ship through a three-dimensional rail-shooter course and fight a mechanical sea-dragon boss.
paragraphs.zh: 驾驶一艘飞船穿越三维轨道射击关卡，并与机械海龙首领战斗。

paragraphs.en: Ride a bicycle past rice paddies and wooden shops as a Japanese summer afternoon turns to dusk.
paragraphs.zh: 骑着自行车穿过稻田和木造商店，此时日本的夏日午后渐渐转为黄昏。

paragraphs.en: Set village objectives and watch residents gather, construct, recruit, and fight.
paragraphs.zh: 设定村庄目标，看着村民聚集、建造、招募并战斗。

paragraphs.en: Wander an endless first-person maze presented through a damaged videotape aesthetic.
paragraphs.zh: 在无尽的第一人称迷宫中漫游，画面呈现出受损录像带的美学风格。

paragraphs.en: Move into a shared town, deliver newspapers, tidy gardens, and build a neighborhood with other players.
paragraphs.zh: 搬进共享小镇，派送报纸、打理花园，与其他玩家一起建设社区。

paragraphs.en: Tend a small sheep farm together in a shared browser world.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个共享的浏览器世界中，一起经营一个小型绵羊农场。

paragraphs.en: Lay out firewalls and security tools to stop malware waves while handling board meetings.
paragraphs.zh: 布置防火墙与安全工具来阻止恶意软件浪潮，同时处理董事会会议。

paragraphs.en: Build up a crystal core and balance idle progress against incoming waves in a tower-defense hybrid.
paragraphs.zh: 在混合塔防玩法中打造晶体核心，在挂机进度与来袭波次之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: Merge tiles to grow a three-dimensional skyline across twelve architectural city themes.
paragraphs.zh: 合并方块，在十二种建筑城市主题中建造不断增长的三维天际线。

paragraphs.en: Fight through an AI research lab in a satirical first-person shooter.
paragraphs.zh: 在一款讽刺意味十足的第一人称射击游戏中，杀出一条穿越 AI 研究实验室的血路。

paragraphs.en: Shape a pot on the wheel, mix a glaze, and see how it survives the kiln.
paragraphs.zh: 在拉坯机上塑造陶器，调配釉料，然后看看它在窑中烧制后效果如何。

paragraphs.en: Take a six-wheeled survey rover across a lonely lunar basin and investigate a silent outpost.
paragraphs.zh: 驾驶一辆六轮勘测漫游车穿越冷清的月球盆地，调查一处寂静的前哨站。

paragraphs.en: Walk a winding jungle trail toward overgrown ruins and a waterfall in a procedural first-person scene.
paragraphs.zh: 在一段程序化生成的第一人称场景中，沿着蜿蜒的丛林小径走向被植被覆盖的遗迹和瀑布。

paragraphs.en: Wire up racks, manage heat, and keep the physical cloud running through outages and price shocks.
paragraphs.zh: 布线机架、管理散热，确保物理云在停电和价格冲击期间持续运行。

paragraphs.en: Command armored vehicles through destructible battlefields with armor and projectile simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 驾驶装甲车穿越可破坏的战场，体验装甲与弹道模拟。

paragraphs.en: Drift through a procedural kart circuit, bank mini-turbos, and chase a cleaner lap.
paragraphs.zh: 在程序化生成的卡丁车赛道上自由漂移，积攒迷你涡轮，追求更干净的圈速。

paragraphs.en: Paint roads and neighborhoods with broad gestures, then watch a city interpret your marks.
paragraphs.zh: 用宽泛的笔触绘制道路和街区，然后看着一座城市诠释你的笔迹。

paragraphs.en: Clear a hostile container yard in a three-minute first-person shooting challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 在一项三分钟的第一人称射击挑战中清剿充满敌意的集装箱货场。

paragraphs.en: Submit it with your source, a play link and real screenshots. Approved games show up in Fresh discoveries.
paragraphs.zh: 连同你的源代码、游戏链接和真实截图一起提交。 通过审核的游戏会出现在「新发现」栏目中。

sents.en: Submit it with your source, a play link and real screenshots.
sents.zh: 连同你的源代码、游戏链接和真实截图一起提交。

sents.en: Approved games show up in Fresh discoveries.
sents.zh: 通过审核的游戏会出现在「新发现」栏目中。

paragraphs.zh: 一个独立的开源游戏合集。 与这些游戏及其创作者无任何隶属关系。

paragraphs.zh: 输入以搜索所有条目。↑↓ 移动，Enter 打开。
